newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Merchants plans B rights offer.
newsitem.headline: China Merchants plans B rights offer.

text.p: China Merchants Shekou Port Service Holdings Co Ltd said on Wednesday it planned to make a three-for-10 rights offer at a price equivalent to 4.50 yuan per rights share to holders of its B shares.

The plan, which needs the approval of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, would be presented at a shareholders meeting scheduled for March 15 in Shenzhen, the company said in a notice in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
The firm said it expected to implement the plan within six months after gaining its shareholder approval.
It said it would use rights proceeds to expand port facilities and repay bank borrowings.
The company had made a three-for-10 rights offer to holders of legal person shares and A shares at 4.50 yuan per rights share last July.

China Merchants, whose B shares have a secondary listing in Singapore, said at the time it would use proceeds from the A share rights offer to renovate port facilities, build warehouses and repay bank loans.
